featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience with Image Media. The print quality was excellent, with vibrant and lively colors that made the photographs look outstanding. The team was very helpful in suggesting the right frame sizes and designing an attractive collage arrangement that suited the available space perfectly.
They also took the time to explain the different frame materials and helped me choose the most suitable option based on both appearance and budget. Their range of frames caters to different price points without compromising on quality.
The work was completed within the promised timeline and stayed within the agreed budget. Overall, a professional team with good product knowledge, quality workmanship, and customer-focused service. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: SRK 2K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have used the services of Image Media owned by Rohit, a few times and must say the services are absolutely top class - quality of work, pricing, delivery timelines...

Rohit is extremely knowledge in this field and offers absolutely brilliant suggestions - which was the case this time around. Wanted some some print solution for a very important landmark event, and he suggested to go for a Coffee Table Book, which his staff Jhanvi helped design so beautifully. It was absolutely loved by the person for whom it was meant for and others who have seen the same. What has been created is a lifelong memory for all of us in the family and Rohit, Jhanvi and Image Media are now etched in the same.

Frankly the service offered by Image Media - Rohit is exhaustive - guess anything concerning print, and any attempt to list down by me would still not cover the entire suite.

I for sure will use Image Media again and strongly recommend them to all.

Thanks again Rohit and the entire team at Image Media

featured_reviews.name: Neerja Bavishi
featured_reviews.review_text: This was my first time interacting with Ritu, got a reference from a building friend. She was very professional in her approach. The print I received from her is perfect. She did also accommodate few of the last minute changes I suggested with no hassle. Strongly recommend her for your personal and professional needs.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Ramchandani
featured_reviews.review_text: Ritu has been so helpful and prompt with her services. I reached out to her pretty last moment with a pretty difficult project. I didn’t have the best quality images for the canvas. Even then she somehow made it possible to deliver a beautiful canvas for my parents’ wedding anniversary. The quality of the canvas is fab. Highly recommended

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Sachdev
featured_reviews.review_text:
We engaged the services of Image Media for an unusual and a very specific requirement.

For our new upcoming bungalow, we wanted the print of a digital abstract image, which was 15 feet tall and 10 feet in width. Our vision was that the print would look more like a painting and less like a digital print, which added to the complexity, in addition to the size.

Working through a number of unknowns, Ritu, Rohit and the Image Media team delivered a stunning outcome. They ensured they were onboard with our vision and sentiment, and helped us choose the right image, material for the various prints, texture, brightness, size, etc. Once the prints were ready, they even assisted with the shipment since the site was in Karnataka, and were on point in terms of packaging the prints and wooden frames appropriately, and also instructing and guiding the wallpaper fitter via repeated conference calls.

Today, the canvas wallpaper is the centerpiece of our interiors and it takes our breath away every time we see it - and of our guests too!

We wouldn't be understating in saying that none of this would've been possible without Image Media's involvement, willingness and passion for their craft. Thank you Ritu, Rohit and team Imaged Media!

Highly, Highly Recommended.

featured_reviews.name: shreash shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I had to order 15+ canvas frames for my restaurant. The task was to select images that would print clearly without blurring, based on our preferences. Team Image Media made it possible. I just sent them the sizes and reference images, and they sourced printable versions of the same or similar images and  delivered within 5 days.

featured_reviews.name: Taqdis Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Definitely a 5/5 printing service!!! Amazing service and premium quality deliverables. The owner is kind, soft spoken and a good listener. I had approached them for a photobook and it turned out to be amazing. Planning to get all my printing done from here.

featured_reviews.name: pooja gala
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got my print done on a canvas sheet here, and I’m really happy with the result! The print quality is excellent – colors came out vibrant and sharp. The team was very helpful, even assisting with edits to make sure everything looked perfect before printing. Great service, friendly staff, and wonderful quality – highly recommend!
